definitions.full: H1597. ganzak גַּנְזַךְ noun [masculine] treasury (Late Hebrew גנזכה treasure ; loan-word from or through Persian compare above & Lag Ges. Abh. 28 ); וְגַנְזַכָּיו 1Chr 28:11 . ᵐ5 τῶν ζακχὼ αὐτοῦ ; but ᵐ5 L τῶν ἀποθηκῶν αὐτοῦ .
